_comment: Narration for the AI voice, one entry per scene (VIDEO_PLAN.md section 13). {caption|voice} gives the voice a different spelling from the captions. {{NAME}} is filled from public/data.json numbers. Scenes 1 and 6 have no narration: our own voices are in the footage.
s2: A recorded motion only works with one brick in one place. Here the bricks and the plates can be anywhere, and there are no coordinates in our code. Picking and placing are learned.
s3: The policy is {pi0.5,|pi zero point five,} a vision-language-action model: camera images, joint positions and a task sentence in, joint actions out. It's fine-tuned on {{EPISODES}} episodes we recorded by teleoperation, with the plates moved around the table.
s4: Inspection is the one scripted step: a fixed pose, and the two faces the fingers don't cover. {Anomalib's|Anomah-libs} {PatchCore|Patch Core} scores only a square around the brick, and it learned from good bricks only.
s5: The verdict becomes the {VLA's|V L A's} next task sentence. The same model then finds the plate of that colour, wherever it stands.
s7: On the arm, {{BRICKS}} bricks went through the whole loop. {{VERDICTS_OK}} verdicts were right: all {{DEF_TOTAL}} defective bricks rejected, and {{FALSE_REJ}} clean ones rejected by mistake. {{PICKS_OK}} of {{PICK_ATTEMPTS}} picks worked, and a brick takes about {{CYCLE_S}} seconds.
s7_draft: The results from the arm go here.
s8: All inference runs on the laptop with {OpenVINO.|Open Veeno.} {pi0.5|pi zero point five} takes about {{VLA_MS}} milliseconds per action chunk on the GPU; {PatchCore,|Patch Core,} about {{INSPECT_MS_LOOP}} per photo.
